summary: Created PRD for landing-page UTM first-touch capture and marketing attribution persistence; updated canonical PRD DB mapping to avoid duplicate UC tracks.

architecturalDecisions.decision: Use first-touch attribution with session persistence and non-overwrite behavior.
architecturalDecisions.reason: Matches current funnel decision needs with minimal implementation complexity and avoids attribution churn within a session.
architecturalDecisions.alternatives: Last-touch or multi-touch attribution were deferred due to higher complexity and weaker time-to-first-paying-customer impact.
